name: feed-activity-timeline
description: Activity feed / timeline (hs-uix Feed) using the standard item shape — the default for any chronological stream (notes, emails, calls, audit log, recent events). Items carry `type` + precomputed `typeVariant` (StatusTag color), `iconName`, `title`, `actor`, `timestamp`, `body`, and inline `meta`. `groupByDate` buckets into Today / Yesterday / older. Toolbar mirrors DataTable: `searchFields` + `filters` (select/multiselect/dateRange) on the left, `sortOptions` + count on the right. `pageSize` adds a 'View more' button. PROP is `items` (not `data`). Precompute `typeVariant` in data — never `$if` it in the spec.
